text.en: Most pet owners praise the trainers and day camp attendants in Kearny Mesa, noting patient guidance from instructors like Mia and Illya. However, boarding feedback is mixed, as several clients reported unfulfilled feeding instructions, missing daily updates, and unsupportive class coaching.

title.en: Effective obedience lessons and neat grooming

text.en: Clients report noticeable behavioral progress following private obedience classes, highlighting calmer leash walking and reduced reactivity around other dogs. Pet parents also commend the grooming work for older dogs and tidy bath finishes, despite occasional complaints regarding boarding outcomes.

Pet owners frequently mention that their dogs enjoy daycare play yards and arrive home happily exhausted after social sessions. Reviewers appreciate that the team accommodates pets with separation anxiety or joint stiffness, allowing older dogs to rest comfortably during baths and day camp visits.

q.en: Do pet owners receive live camera access during daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients mention checking live webcams and receiving photo updates of their dogs in the play yards.

q.en: Is an introductory evaluation required before enrolling in daycare?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe attending an initial evaluation visit where staff assess the dog temperament and tour the facility.

q.en: Does the centre offer individual obedience training?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently discuss one-on-one training sessions that target leash pulling and dog reactivity.

q.en: Can senior dogs receive grooming services at this facility?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report that groomers handle arthritic and elderly dogs gently without requiring them to stand for prolonged periods.
